summary: NNN REIT filed an 8-K announcing a new equity distribution agreement effective August 6, 2026, replacing the prior agreement dated August 3, 2023. The agreement allows the company to issue and sell up to 25,000,000 shares of common stock through multiple agents, with potential forward sale agreements where forward purchasers borrow and sell shares. This is an at-the-market (ATM) program, not a traditional capital return, but the forward structure can defer share issuance and potentially support capital management. The filing does not state any specific pricing, premium, or board recommendation. What to watch: aggregate sales pace and any forward settlement metrics.
